callouts.title: 问题1.1
callouts.body: 证明，序列$\eta_n = \left\{\frac{n}{2\pi}\right\}$形成的集合作为$[0,1]$区间当中的稠密子集。其中$\{x\}$表示实数$x$的小数部分。

if_problem.statement_en: Prove that the set formed by the sequence $\eta_n = \left\{\frac{n}{2\pi}\right\}$ is dense in the interval $[0,1]$, where $\{x\}$ denotes the fractional part of the real number $x$.

callouts.title: 定理1.2:kronecker定理
callouts.body: 对于给定的无理数$\alpha$，以及$\forall \beta\in\mathbb{R}$，$\forall \varepsilon > 0$都存在正整数$q$以及整数$p$使得$$|q\alpha-\beta-p|<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: For a given irrational number $\alpha$, for every $\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$, there exist a positive integer $q$ and an integer $p$ such that $$|q\alpha-\beta-p|<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: 定理1.3：kronecker定理(版本2)
callouts.body: 对于给定的无理数$\alpha$，以及$\forall \beta\in\mathbb{R}$，对任意足够小的$\varepsilon > 0$存在正整数$q_{\varepsilon}$使得$$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-\beta||<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: For a given irrational number $\alpha$, for every $\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ and every sufficiently small $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists a positive integer $q_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-\beta||<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: 定理1.4:Dirichlet定理
callouts.body: 对于无理数$\alpha$以及任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$q_{\varepsilon}$使得$$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha||<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: For an irrational number $\alpha$ and any $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a positive integer $q_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$||q_{\varepsilon}\alpha||<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: 与一开始的问题的关系
callouts.body: 回到“问题1”，我们发现，如果我们可以证明Kronecker定理成立，那么我们可以令$\alpha=\frac{1}{2\pi}$,于是由于这是一个无理数，所以对于$\forall \beta\in(0,1)$以及任意足够小的$\varepsilon$，那么一定存在一个正整数$p_{\varepsilon}>0$以及整数$p_{\varepsilon}$使得$$|q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-\beta-p_{\varepsilon}|<\varepsilon\iff \beta-\varepsilon<q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-p_{\varepsilon}<\beta+\varepsilon$$此处我们取$0<\varepsilon<\min\{\beta,1-\beta\}$,从而可以保证$\beta-\varepsilon>0,\beta+\varepsilon<1$于是$q_{\varepsilon}\alpha-p_{\varepsilon}=\{q_{\varepsilon}\alpha\}$。这便意味着$\eta_n = \left\{\frac{n}{2\pi}\right\}$形成的集合在$(0,1)$当中稠密。

callouts.title: 定理1.5：Kronecker定理（版本3）
callouts.body: 若实数$\frac{\beta}{\alpha} \not \in \mathbb{Q}$，那么集合$\alpha \mathbb{Z}+\beta \mathbb{Z}$在实数中稠密（欧氏拓扑）。

if_problem.statement_en: If $\frac{\beta}{\alpha} \not \in \mathbb{Q}$, then the set $\alpha \mathbb{Z}+\beta \mathbb{Z}$ is dense in the real numbers (with the Euclidean topology).

callouts.title: Dirichlet定理(版本2)
callouts.body: $\alpha$是无理数，对于任意正整数$n$存在正整数$q\leq n$使得$$0<||q\alpha||<\frac{1}{n}$$

if_problem.statement_en: Let $\alpha$ be irrational. For every positive integer $n$, there exists a positive integer $q\leq n$ such that $$0<||q\alpha||<\frac{1}{n}.$$

callouts.title: Dirichlet定理(版本2)的推论1
callouts.body: 对于无理数$\alpha$以及任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在无限多个正整数$q$使得$$||q\alpha||<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: For an irrational number $\alpha$ and any $\varepsilon>0$, there exist infinitely many positive integers $q$ such that $$||q\alpha||<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: Dirichlet定理(版本2)，推论2
callouts.body: 对于无理数$\alpha$存在无数多个正整数$q$使得$$q||q\alpha||<1$$

if_problem.statement_en: For an irrational number $\alpha$, there exist infinitely many positive integers $q$ such that $$q||q\alpha||<1.$$

callouts.title: 一个观察
callouts.body: 如果两个数$x,y$模$1$的余数的差小于一个足够小的$r>0$，那么$||x-y||<r$。因为$$|\varepsilon(x)-\varepsilon(y)|<r\iff |x-y-(E(x)-E(y))|<r$$此时如果$r<\frac{1}{2}$，这便意味着$x-y$这个实数与$E(x)-E(y)$这个整数的距离小于$r<\frac{1}{2}$,这意味着$E(x)-E(y)$就是距离$x-y$最近的整数，从而$$||x-y||<r$$

if_problem.statement_en: If the difference between the residues of two numbers $x,y$ modulo $1$ is less than a sufficiently small $r>0$, then $||x-y||<r$.

callouts.title: 证明的主要想法
callouts.body: 那么根据这个观察，我们如果能在正整数的某个子集$A_n$里面，找到两个$q_1,q_2$使得$q_1\alpha,q_2\alpha$他们彼此之间模1的余数的距离小于$\frac{1}{n}$，并且保证$1\leq q_2-q_1\leq n$那么我们也就完成了对Dirichlet定理的证明。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Find Two Close Fractional Parts and Subtract
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove Dirichlet-type approximation, look for two multiples $q_1\alpha$ and $q_2\alpha$ whose fractional parts are very close. Their difference then produces an integer $q_2-q_1$ with controlled size and small distance to an integer.
if_strategy_template.applicability: This strategy applies when one wants to prove existence of integers $q$ such that $||q\alpha||$ is small, especially via pigeonhole arguments on fractional parts modulo $1$.
